messages:
Rachel: Quick coordination — planning to enable the `enable_safe_mode_v3` config across hosted + dedicated tomorrow morning in the 09:00–10:00 PT quiet window. Who can own the flip and immediate smoke checks?

Matt: I can do the flip at 09:05 PT and be ready to rollback if needed. I'll be oncall that window.

Alexa: I'll run the smoke suite and report back. Quick smoke checklist I normally run: 
- `curl /health` on the runtime
- run 3 sample prompt requests through the canary route
- check `infra.cache.miss_rate` and `infer.errors.rate` for spikes
- verify tracing spans show normal downstream latencies
:white_check_mark:

Sam: Add two things to watch: `metric: infer.errors.rate` and `metric: p50_infer_ms`. If errors up >0.3% or p50 up >25% we should pause. I'll post a quick Grafana snapshot link before the flip.

Kevin: Rollout/rollback plan: staged by shard tiers — 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m holds. Rollback is a single API call to the flag service or fallback to `safe_defaults=true`. Rollback command (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>"
  -d '{"key":"enable_safe_mode_v3","value":false}'
```
I'll keep the runbook open.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle job created: id `job-2026-03-24-09` (owner: Matt). ETA 09:05 PT.

Rachel: Proposed acceptance gates: no error rate increase >0.3%, p50 latency increase <=25%, no high-severity traces. If any gate fails — immediate rollback and notify infra-ops + product. Who is primary for rollback execution?

Matt: I'll be primary for the first window. I'll execute the rollback command if Alexa flags a failure. Posting the quick API call I'll use (token replaced):
`curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"key":"enable_safe_mode_v3","value":false}'`

Alexa: Sounds good. I'll post a single-line smoke result 2 minutes post-flip: `smoke: PASS` or `smoke: FAIL — <short reason>` and attach the Grafana snapshot. I'll also paste one example input+response for QA.

Sam: I'll capture and share the Grafana panels (errors, p50, cache misses) 1m before flip and 3m after. Also can we add a short retention note — if everything is green at 30m, proceed to the next ramp to 30%?

Rachel: Yes — ramp to 30% at +10m if green, then 100% at +20m if still green. Thanks all — Matt pls ping here when you start and again after each ramp. Alexa pls keep the one-line updates.

Matt: Will do. Starting checklist saved locally and I'll paste a final `go / no-go` at 09:04 PT.

Alexa: Got it. I'll be standing by.

Rachel: Excellent — tagging infra-ops for visibility. @infra-ops : please standby for any cross-tenant issues.
